name: @caffeine/email-worker
description: Phase 1 Option B experimental IMAP worker — runs the generic IMAP/SMTP adapter's socket work (ImapFlow + mailparser) in a real Node.js runtime instead of Supabase Edge/Deno, to test whether that eliminates the reproducible 'Already logged out' ImapFlow lifecycle crash observed under Deno. See src/imapCore.ts's header comment for the full context.
